text:
sara.nguyen: Quick ping — can someone take a look at PR #4827? It touches KMS key rotation hooks and the audit log schema; compliance needs sign-off before we can merge. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4827 :eyes:

devon.lee: On it, assigning myself. I'll check the HSM path + error handling. Any tests I should run locally?

maria.perez: Heads up — I left inline comments about rotation metadata shape and the timestamp format we standardised last quarter. Also please ensure rotation_reason is not nullable.

anshuman: I can review the auth/audit side after lunch (~14:30). If CI is green and we get two approvals we can merge and kick off the migration.

sara.nguyen: CI currently failing on one audit test, looks related to timestamp parsing in audit_log_test::rotation_metadata.

ci-bot: build #4827 — unit tests failed (3/77). Failing test: audit_log_test::rotation_metadata. Logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/4827/logs

devon.lee: pushed a small fix to parsing (force UTC on parse). I also added a unit test for the nil rotation_reason case. PTAL @maria.perez

maria.perez: quick scan — patch looks good and covers the case I commented on. Left one nit about exception message, but not blocking. Giving LGTM. :+1:

sec-bot: Automated check: change touches auditable events. Please update audit_events.yml with the new event code (kms.key_rotation) and add a brief entry to compliance/release-notes.md.

anshuman: added audit_events.yml entry and a tiny note in release-notes in a follow-up commit in the same PR. Re-ran unit tests locally — all green for me.

sara.nguyen: Awesome, thanks all. Plan: merge at 17:00 PST if no other blockers, then run the migration job in staging and a canary deploy. If anyone sees issues speak now or comment on the PR. :shipit:
